correctness.rationale: For rank-two A:R3→R2 with kernel normal h, reduce eight independent equiprobable sign vectors to four antipodal classes. Distinct image-line mergers are governed exactly by the six cross products, i.e. equalities of absolute coordinates of h; a zero image is possible only for all three nonzero coordinates of equal magnitude. Four class-mass patterns give deficiency probabilities 4^(1-L), 2^-L+2*4^-L, 2^(1-L), 3*2^-L-2*4^-L and zero-image atom 4^-L only in the fourth case. Inclusion–exclusion on line occupancies proves all L>=2. For AA^T=I2, E||A-QQ^TA||_F²=Pr(rank<2)+Pr(Y=0) by trace. Independently enumerated rank distributions of actual cube samples, including the axis and diagonal boundaries; exact rational checks agreed. The 2x3 coisometry existence and Gaussian contrast are valid.
residual_risks: Exact arithmetic, unbiased iid signs and 2x3 rank-two targets are essential; no numerical-conditioning claim.
